extraction.summary_en: Minutes of the 19 January 2017 mixed general assembly of ARCHEAN TECHNOLOGIES (SAS). The assembly authorizes a capital reduction from 368,102 euros to 217,241 euros (reduction of 150,861 euros maximum) by buyback and cancellation of 150,861 shares at €2.72 per share held by minority shareholders, subject to bank financing and creditor-opposition clearance.

events.date_basis: Decision date is 19 January 2017 (assembly meeting), but realization is conditional on bank financing and creditor-opposition clearance, neither shown as completed in this filing.

evidence.quote_fr: autorise la réduction du capital social pour un montant maximum de 150 861 euros, pour le ramener de 368 102 euros à 217 241 euros, par voie de rachat d'actions détenues par les associés minoritaires, en vue de leur annulation, selon les modalités fixées par l'article L. 225-207 du Code de commerce. Cette opération sera réalisée par le rachat de 150 861 actions de 1 euro de nominal chacune, au prix de 2,72 euros par action.

events.gloss_en: Assembly authorizes buyback and cancellation of 150,861 shares (€1 par value) at €2.72 per share to reduce capital from €368,102 to €217,241.

snapshots.as_of_basis: Before the capital reduction decision, per the assembly meeting date and the capital stated in the meeting header.

evidence.quote_fr: Société par actions simplifiée au capital de 368 102 euros

issues: The capital reduction is conditional on bank financing and creditor-opposition clearance (p4.1-4), neither of which is shown as satisfied in this filing. The statutes are not reproduced, so the post-reduction capital cannot be verified against updated articles.
